description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers related to spark ignition logic in a engine control firmware.

methods.name: isInjectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if fuel injection is enabled.

methods.name: turnSparkPinHigh
methods.description: Sets the spark pin to a high state to trigger ignition.

methods.name: turnSparkPinLow
methods.description: Sets the spark pin to a low state to end ignition trigger.

methods.name: getNumberOfSparks
methods.description: Returns the number of sparks based on ignition mode.

methods.name: getCoilDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates the coil duty cycle based on RPM.
